title: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Expanding the Water Trigger) Bill 2023
short_title: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Expanding the Water Trigger) Bill 2023

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would make more gas mining projects require federal environmental assessment and approval.
It would replace the current category of coal seam gas with a broader one covering all unconventional gas, including shale and tight gas.
The environment minister would have to consult a scientific committee when such projects are deemed controlled actions.
changes: Expands the water trigger to all unconventional gas developments.
Requires project proponents to refer unconventional gas actions for a controlled action decision.
Gives the environment minister a call-in power to request referrals.
Requires the minister to seek scientific advice from the expert committee on unconventional gas and large coal mining projects.
summary.affected: Proponents of unconventional gas developments and the federal environment minister.
